evidence_available_when_recorded.collection_iteration1: 7 of 8 rows complete; terminal conditions 3/4 x4 (pants), 2/5 x2 (short tops); 0 settled successes
evidence_available_when_recorded.statement: No trained checkpoint exists and no development or test outcome for any candidate has been observed. Every change below is therefore made blind to candidate performance.

was.stretch: development H10 >= 6/8 with no H50 regression

both_require: no H50 regression below the MATCHED baseline

iterations.was: one iteration, plus a second only if the first improved development and passed the retention guard
iterations.now: up to three full collect-train-evaluate iterations; a disappointing iteration is diagnosed and the next changes exactly one major factor; bounded by the caps below, whichever binds first

baseline_development.was: reused from the horizon pilot (H10 0/8, H50 4/8)
baseline_development.now: measured fresh under this campaign on the identical 16 development rows, so baseline and candidate share runner, sources and conditions
baseline_development.why: the mandate requires matched baseline/candidate conditions, and the pilot itself recorded deformable-simulation replay drift, so run-to-run variation on identical seeds is not established to be zero. The pilot's 0/8 and 4/8 are kept as a reproducibility cross-check, not as the comparison.

frozen_test.was: run for baseline and candidate after iteration 1
frozen_test.now: reserved for the FINAL selected checkpoint and the baseline only; run once, after selection is complete; its results are never fed back into any training or selection decision

eligibility: checkpoint reloads with config_matches_baseline and a finite action

within_iteration_checkpoint_rule.unchanged: evaluate step_000300; fall back to step_000200 only if step_000300 breaches the retention guard
within_iteration_checkpoint_rule.added_double_breach_case: if step_000300 and step_000200 both breach, the iteration has no guard-passing candidate: nothing is evaluated and the breach becomes the diagnosis for the next iteration

budget_caps.rationale: The frozen manifest capped iteration 1 only. The mandate requires a conservative finite cap within the existing allocation (account eecs; partitions gpu, ampere, share) before further production submission. No resources are purchased and no allocation is increased.

storage.context: /nfs/hpc/share is a SHARED filesystem measured at 90% used with 160 GB free on 2026-09-23; this campaign must not be the reason it fills

automation.driver: scripts/driver.py, restartable and duplicate-safe; state in ledger/driver_state.json
automation.progression: each stage is followed by a dependent CPU tick job that re-runs the driver, which submits the next stage; a time-based watchdog tick recovers a crashed chain
automation.next_iteration_choice: an explicit committed plan (plans/iterationK.json) written from closed-loop evidence takes precedence; if none exists after a 90-minute grace period, the preregistered default rule in driver.py applies, so progression never waits on a chat prompt

unchanged: the development and frozen-test row definitions and seeds
the prohibition on H50 self-oracle plans from student-visited roots as recovery labels
